description: PrefectHQ org baseline. Every repo extends this. Managers auto-detected; archetype presets (:python, :terraform, :go, :node, :helm, :flux) add grouping/scoping on top.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain day-0 cooldown: wait 7 days before bumping npm and PyPI packages (easy to publish; run install/build hooks -- the main day-0 attack surface) and GitHub Actions (run in CI with secrets). Terraform providers, docker images, and go modules are left on immediate updates -- lower day-0 risk and we do not want to delay their security patches.
Supply-chain day-0 cooldown for GitHub Actions (see the npm/pypi rule above).
Keep each major bump as its own PR and label it. Majors are the riskiest updates and deserve isolated review.

Group minor/patch bumps per ecosystem so each PR is one coherent, reviewable unit and a failure in one ecosystem does not block another. Majors are excluded (they split out per the rule above). Archetype presets add finer sub-groups on top.
Group Go module minor/patch bumps into one PR.
Group Python minor/patch bumps (pep621/uv, pip-tools, plain pip) into one PR.
Group container image minor/patch bumps (Dockerfiles and docker-compose) into one PR.
Group Terraform provider/module minor/patch bumps into one PR.
Group Helm chart-dependency minor/patch bumps into one PR.

Group GitHub Actions bumps into their own PR. Universal: every repo has workflows. separateMultipleMajor is disabled here so multiple available majors of an action collapse into this one PR rather than splitting a PR per major.
Group mise tool bumps into their own PR. Universal: every repo uses .mise.toml.

Automerge mise minor/patch bumps once CI passes, so routine tool updates do not need a review. Majors are excluded: a mise major changes the toolchain every other CI job runs on, so those still open a PR for a human. platformAutomerge hands the merge to GitHub native auto-merge, which respects branch protection and merges as soon as checks go green rather than on the next Renovate run.
